name: meter-6-8-bpm90
description: 6/8, bpm 90, lengthBars 4 -> lengthBeats 12

name: roles
description: role mapping: chords x2, bass, melody x2, drums, none

name: lane-volume
description: volume lane on a fader of 0.5

name: lane-pan
description: pan lanes that saturate (pan 0.5 / -0.25) and one that does not

name: lane-cutoff
description: cutoff multiplier lane 1,2,0.5,10,0.1

name: lane-equal-beats
description: two points on the same beat make a jump

name: lane-equal-beats-at-zero
description: two points on beat 0

name: sends
description: two returns; sends of 0.5/0.25/0.75/1; a send to a missing return; a zero send

name: loop-no-content-length
description: loop:true without contentLengthBeats: wave5 plays one pass

name: loop-content-length
description: clip 2..10, loop period 3: three passes, last one cut by the clip end

name: loop-drum-content-length
description: drum clip 0..8, loop period 2 beats = 8 steps, with an open hat the closed hat chokes

name: loop-drum-offgrid-period
description: drum clip 0..2, loop period 0.6 beat (2.4 steps): repeats land between steps

name: link-chain
description: A owns notes, B links A, C links B (same track, same type, same length)

name: link-cross-track
description: a clip on another track links a clip of the first track

name: link-length-mismatch
description: same track, same type, but the link is shorter than its source

name: link-broken-cyclic
description: missing target, type mismatch, owns content, two-clip cycle, self link, plus one normal clip

name: link-of-looped-source
description: a link to a source that loops (source unrolled), and a link with its own loop

name: swing
description: project swing 35 with off-grid and on-grid material

name: macros
description: one instrument with macros and an existing param, one without

name: legacy-fields
description: legacyBarLimit, loopRange and legacyClipSettings

name: over-limit-steps
description: drum clip with 192 steps per bar (main allows at most 128)

name: over-limit-events
description: 6 notes looped every 1/16 beat for 256 beats = 24576 events (wave5 allows 100000, main runtime 20000)

name: audio-clips
description: audio clips: two share a legacy asset id, one has another, one has none

name: mixer-effects
description: mute, solo, fader, pan, the five wave5 effects at their wave5 defaults (eq +6/0/-3), a chord track and a section

name: effects-order-eq-enabled
description: saved order reverb, filter, eq(enabled): wave5 re-orders to eq, filter, reverb

name: effects-order-eq-disabled
description: saved order reverb, filter, eq(disabled): wave5 keeps the saved order

name: effects-adjusted
description: values main cannot hold (filter 0.7 Hz / Q 0.15, delay 1 s) and an effect type main does not have

name: return-reverb
description: addReverbReturn + setTrackSend(0.5) on the Melody track

name: lane-first-point-late
description: lanes whose first point is after beat 0 (wave5 holds the first value before it; main would use the fader)

name: lanes-unplayable
description: master lanes, a drum cutoff lane and a bus cutoff lane (wave5 never plays them) next to playable drum/bus volume+pan lanes

name: swing-loop-cut
description: swing 50, clip 0..8, period 2, note at 1.75 for 1 beat (starts 900 ticks, ends 960)

name: song-end
description: lengthBars 4: a clip crossing the end, a clip after it, chords and sections crossing / after the end

name: song-length-80
description: lengthBars 80 WITHOUT legacyBarLimit: wave5 loads it as 64 bars (256 beats); the note at 290 never sounds

name: overlap-clips
description: two overlapping clips on one track (wave5 load moves the later one to t-a-overlap-1)

name: link-longer
description: a link LONGER than its source (4 beats vs 2): wave5 plays the source content once

name: link-drum
description: drum source with 12 steps per bar; an alias that wrongly carries stepsPerBar 16; a cross-track drum link

name: drum-no-steps-3-4
description: 3/4, drum clip without stepsPerBar (wave5 and main both read 16)

name: loop-false-with-content-length
description: loop:false but contentLengthBeats 2: wave5 plays all notes once

name: type-mismatch-content
description: notes on a drum track and drum hits on an instrument track (wave5 plays neither)

name: drum-same-step-hits
description: kick step0 x2 (100,80), closedHat step2 x3 (60,110,70), snare step4 once: wave5 plays all 6

name: loop-drum-snap-collision
description: clip 0..2, period 0.6 beat (2.4 steps), kick step0 (100) and kick step2 (120): snapped repeats land on steps 2 and 7 twice

name: clip-type-mismatch-played
description: instrument track, clip type drum with one MIDI note (pitch 60, 1 beat) and no drumEvents: wave5 plays the one 480-tick note

name: over-limit-density
description: 300 notes within 0.3 beat (total far below 20000)

name: realistic-song
description: template 8bar-pop edited with wave5 mutations: swing, loop, link, copy, macros, cross-clip choke, return + sends, 5 effects, lanes
